title: Apprehensive
summary: APPREHEN'SIVE, adjective 1. Quick to understand; as, an apprehensive scholar. 2. Fearful; in expectation of evil; as, we were apprehensive of fatal consequences. [This is the usual sense of the word.]

inlines.v: APPREHEN'SIVE, adjective 1. Quick to understand; as, an apprehensive scholar. 2. Fearful; in expectation of evil; as, we were apprehensive of fatal consequences. [This is the usual sense of the word.] 3. Suspicious; inclined to believe; as, I am apprehensive he does not understand me. 4. Sensible; feeling; perceptive. [Rarely used.]
